scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p packages/core && tsc --noEmit -p packages/solid && tsc --noEmit -p packages/react && tsc --noEmit -p packages/eslint && tsc -p tsconfig.consumer.json
scripts.lint: biome check packages/ tests/ demos/react-todo/src demos/portal/src demos/react-portal/src scripts/
scripts.lint:fix: biome check --write packages/ tests/ demos/react-todo/src demos/portal/src demos/react-portal/src scripts/
scripts.format: biome format --write packages/ tests/ demos/react-todo/src demos/portal/src demos/react-portal/src scripts/
scripts.test:demos: npm --prefix demos/portal test && npm --prefix demos/react-portal test
scripts.typecheck:demos: npm --prefix demos/todo run typecheck && npm --prefix demos/react-todo run typecheck && npm --prefix demos/portal run typecheck && npm --prefix demos/react-portal run typecheck
